 Follow Ryan Seacrest Has First Ever Spray Tan — and Costars Are Shocked
 Brittany Sims Thu, November 12, 2026 at 6:05 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Ryan Seacrest (left) on his radio show talking about his first spray tan, (right) Tanya Rad shocked when he told her what he did - On Air With Ryan Seacrest/Instagram Ryan Seacrest might be an expert in hosting, but there is one thing he is not very good at — getting a spray tan. The Wheel of Fortune host admitted that he got his first-ever one recently, but had an epic fail with it.
 "Well, can you tell I went to Tarts & Sugar?" Seacrest asked his On Air radio show cohosts.
 "Sugared + Bronzed," the women laughed and corrected him.
 "My debut spray tanning was last night. Never done it before," he said as Seacrest shared that he did a level two. Sisanie, his cohost, said she told him to do a three. "I was nervous," Seacrest said. "They told me if I go too far, you can't really downgrade it. So, I did it, but you can't tell?"
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I can't tell," Sisanie said.
 "I can't tell at all," Tanya Rad replied.
 Another crew member chimed in off-screen, "You look exactly the same."
 "Oh, well, maybe that's good," Seacrest said.
 Rad asked if he did his face, and Seacrest said, "No. I didn't do my face. Why would I do my face?"
 "Ohhh. Well, that's why," Sisanie said.
 "You do your face in a spray tan?" the American Idol host asked. "Why? I don't want that stuff on my face to cause a zit."
 Rad said that it doesn't cause zits. Sisanie said that he didn't want his head to be a different color from the rest of his body.

 "Uhhh, can I blend it somehow or something?" Seacrest asked.
 Advertisement Advertisement "If you put makeup on," Sisanie laughed. She went on to say that no one can see it because he didn't do his face and he is wearing long sleeves.
 "They told me to let it sink in," the host said.
 "Did you give it the six hours?" Rad asked.
 "Before I did what?" Seacrest wondered.
 "Showered," she replied.
 "No," he said.
 "You just washed it all off!" Rad said.
 "100 percent. He went home and washed it all off within the hour," Sianie said to Rad.
 With Seacrest being on TV often, it is surprising that he has never had a spray tan. Fans laughed in the comments while others said they were "disappointed."
